proposed_comments.title: Edit-mode conflict check can miss a real duplicate
proposed_comments.body: `HasConflictingModifierMapping`/`IsDuplicateMapping` gate edit mode with `upperLimit = isEditMode ? 1 : 0` and test `conflictCount > upperLimit`. That count tolerance can't distinguish "matches the edited row" from "collides with one other mapping" — both give `conflictCount == 1`, so editing a row into a value that duplicates one different existing mapping is accepted. The public `Validate*` methods already thread an `editingRemapping`; could these use it to exclude the edited row by identity instead of by count?

This revision adds the `condition` field so alone remaps round-trip through `aloneSingleKeyReMap`. A unit test that saves an "alone" single-key remap and asserts it reloads into the alone table (and an "always" one into the regular table) would lock the contract down.
proposed_comments.title: Add load/save round-trip tests for the condition contract
